reports.summary: 本轮按严格的新颖性与相关性标准复查了 arXiv、公开项目页、实验室与公司研究页面、GitHub 及相关研究信息后，没有发现 2026-08-10 之后首次公开、且将灵巧机器人手或灵巧操作作为核心贡献的新增条目。当前可见的近邻结果要么早于本轮时间窗，要么没有达到“灵巧手是主线贡献”的收录门槛，因此本次不新增项目。
reports.summary_en: After a strict novelty and relevance pass over arXiv, public project pages, lab and company research pages, GitHub, and related research sources, I did not find any newly published item after 2026-08-10 that made dexterous robot hands or dexterous manipulation a central contribution. The nearby results visible today were either earlier than the cutoff or not hand-centric enough, so no items are added in this run.
